title: E-Waste Safety: Hierarchical CNN with Adaptive Fuzzy Temporal Supervisory Risk Model (code and results)
description: Code, trained checkpoints, experiment scripts and result tables for a simulation study of pre-shred lithium-ion battery fire prevention: two-stage EfficientNet-B0 battery detection, Mamdani fuzzy risk, corroboration-gated adaptive temporal memory, CNN-confidence fusion and a latching supervisory state machine. All sensor data are simulated; image datasets are public and must be downloaded separately (see docs/DATA.md).
